_om: Admiralen in English (Admiral, rusj.no/en/admiral/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The fleet is the classic one British players know: carrier, battleship, cruiser, submarine, destroyer. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Plasser flåten din i det skjulte og senk: Place your fleet in secret and sink your opponent's ships before yours go to the bottom.
Dra skipene dit du vil, eller trykk på «: Drag the ships where you want them, or tap ‘Random’. Ships can't touch each other – not even diagonally.
Trykk på en rute i fiendens farvann og s: Tap a square in enemy waters, then ‘Fire!’. A splash means a miss, a bang means a hit.
Når alle rutene til et skip er truffet,: Once every square of a ship has been hit, it sinks. Whoever sinks the other player's whole fleet first wins.
Rundt et senket skip er det bare vann –: Around a sunk ship there's only water – those squares are marked straight away.
Trykk på samme rute to ganger for å fyre: Tap the same square twice to fire straight away.
Treffer du et skip, prøv rutene ved side: Hit a ship? Try the squares next to it. Ships always lie in a straight line.
To spillere: gi mobilen videre etter hve: Two players: pass the phone over after every shot, and look away while the other player places their fleet.
Mobilen ser bare sine egne skudd – den j: The phone only sees its own shots – it never cheats.
Fires a bit blindly. Good for little ones.
Searches in a pattern and follows up its hits.
Regner ut hvor skipene mest sannsynlig l: Works out where the ships are most likely to be. Good luck!
Whoever is first on the list places first.
Fem skip: hangarskip, slagskip, fregatt,: Five ships: aircraft carrier, battleship, cruiser, submarine and destroyer.
Fire skip på et mindre hav – raskere sla: Four ships on a smaller sea – quicker battles.

Dra et skip dit du vil – eller trykk på: Drag a ship where you want it – or tap the ship, then a new square. Tap it twice to turn it.
Sikter på {rute}. Trykk «Fyr!» – eller p: Aiming at {rute}. Tap ‘Fire!’ – or tap the square again.
Din tur! Trykk på en rute i fiendens far: Your turn! Tap a square in enemy waters.
{navn}, din tur! Trykk på en rute i fien: {navn}, your turn! Tap a square in enemy waters.
Hele flåten til mobilen ligger på bunnen: The phone's whole fleet is at the bottom of the sea. Well done, Admiral!
Mobilen var skarp i dag. Godt forsøk – t: The phone was on form today. Good try – go for a rematch!
Trykk på et skip først – eller dra det: Tap a ship first – or drag it
Ikke plass til å snu skipet her: No room to turn the ship here
Det er bare vann rundt et senket skip: There's only water around a sunk ship
Slaget blir borte. Stillingen fra tidlig: This battle will be lost. The score from earlier battles is saved.
